name: What is the typical process for designing and installing built-in shelves?
description: The process includes consultation, measurements, custom design, material selection, fabrication, and on-site installation and finishing.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and installing built-in shelves?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your needs, design preferences, and the intended use of the shelving. We then take precise measurements of the space. Following this, our team creates custom designs and material selections for your approval. Once approved, the shelves are fabricated in our workshop before being expertly installed and finished on-site in your Alameda or Berkeley home. We work closely with clients to ensure the final product meets their expectations and complements their existing space.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes consultation, measurements, custom design, material selection, fabrication, and on-site installation and finishing.
